# Munwan Car Rental

> Premium car hire across Kenya — self-drive, chauffeur-driven, safari
> packages and airport transfers. Based in Nairobi, serving the whole
> country. Cars from $28/day with full insurance, GPS and free JKIA
> airport delivery.

## About

Munwan Car Rental is a Kenyan car hire company offering a 28-vehicle
fleet ranging from compact sedans to safari-ready 4x4 Land Cruisers.
Bookings can be made online with instant confirmation. Payment is by
M-Pesa, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay or bank transfer.

Services:
- Normal self-drive car hire (minimum 2 days)
- Corporate hire with invoicing (minimum 5 days)
- Safari packages to Maasai Mara, Amboseli, Tsavo and other parks
- Airport transfers to and from JKIA and Mombasa
- Chauffeur-driven hire with a professional driver
